newsitem.title: USA: AnnTaylor sees Q4 $0.08/shr closings charge.
newsitem.headline: AnnTaylor sees Q4 $0.08/shr closings charge.

text.p: AnnTaylor Stores Corp said it plans to close all nine of its Ann Taylor stand-alone shoe stores in 1997 and take a one-time charge in the fourth quarter of $0.08 per share on the closings.

The charge will cover the writeoff of the net book value of the nine stores, projected operating losses in such stores prior to closing, estimated lease liabilities and related costs, the retailer said.
In 1996, the nine Studio shoe stores had total net sales of about $4.6 million and had a pre-tax operating loss of about $1.1 million before allocation of central overhead expenses.
The company said it was closing the stores "because it had concluded that the concept was inconsistent with Ann Taylor's corporate strategy and to improve overall profitability."
